description: Return the master Google Sheet and authenticated workspace links, including the Year-End screen link. Show only 1–2 relevant returned links. Open/view/edit spreadsheet: Sheet. Receipt added: Review expenses + Sheet; income added: Review income + Sheet. Gmail scan/connection: Scan Gmail. Bank/card connection/reconciliation: Reconcile. Configuration: Automation Hub/General Settings. Category/G/L/account codes: Category management. Client/project/trip groups: Group management. Personal classification: Personal rules. Client billing: use returned clientBillingHandoffs for the current step: manageClients (client list), tagReadyExpenses (blank/default-Business rows), createClientReport (report by assigned group). Named client's exact grouping: search_expenses then group_expenses. Google Photos: returned authenticated picker with consent. Receipt storage: returned Drive folder only; never invent/request a folder ID. Complete unambiguous cash expense/mileage: direct write tool. Multiple/incomplete expenses, credits/refunds, tax/tip/per diem or visual review: Manual expense. Route/repeated/calendar/rideshare mileage, per diem or review: Mileage and travel. Income file without chat attachment or complex review: Import income (previews every row). Team setup: returned role-aware handoff (solo owner: Add teammates; owner/co-admin: Team Management); explain owner-access requirements. Complex reports: Create report. Read-only; no row changes.
name: get_spreadsheet_url
